audit.why: Even lane, TF wins map via Destiny roams, Malzahar wins extended lane/late — matches 52.17% WR and kit reality.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carries blanket 'Skill' on rows 4/5/6 while content win[] says Malzahar/TF/Malzahar (matching the packet chart). Two answers rendered to the same question.
audit.why: Malzahar 6 (point-click Nether Grasp) beats TF 6 in lane; TF first-item Lich Bane + Destiny roams favor TF; Malzahar's 80s-CD R and perma-push out-value late.
audit.corrected: phases[4/5/6].side moved to Malzahar/Twisted Fate/Malzahar with whys rewritten to match; content win[] already correct so left alone per chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown number; dos/donts bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles; nothing stated that Malzahar's passive (Void Shift) grants CC immunity, so a gold card into fresh passive does not stun.
audit.why: Riot passive text: damage reduction and crowd control immunity until damaged/CC'd. Nether Grasp 140/110/80s, Q silence on 6s, are the real trade timers.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 140/110/80 and 6s; gold-card bullet now says to break Void Shift with Q/auto before the card.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: His Nether Grasp is point-click and answers your all-in — even Destiny roams risk the lock. His 6 outweighs yours in lane.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks hard and he stays lane-bound — cash Destiny into side lanes his R can't reach.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: His Rylai's-Liandry's perma-push and 80s Nether Grasp out-value you late — close off your item spike before this point.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It governs your forward steps. - W gold card spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp runs 140/110/80s — once he suppresses anyone, you own a two-minute window to shove and Destiny. - His Q silence sits on a 6s cooldown: bait it before you step up. - W gold card spent on poke is a death you scheduled; hold it for his walk-up.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Break his passive with a Q or auto first — a gold card into fresh Void Shift stuns nothing; lock yellow for the follow-up.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: He permapushes with Malefic Visions anyway — matching him mid past 6 wastes the Destiny windows the side lanes are paying for.

notes: missingInteractions flagged an 'execute-threshold' for Malefic Visions (E); Riot's text describes a spreading DoT with mana refund on kill, not a threshold execute — derived flag misfire, so no execute claim was written. Content-layer win[] already matched the packet chart, so full-layer sides were moved alone per the chart rule. Malzahar passive granting CC immunity (gold card negated while Void Shift is intact) is from Riot's own passive text.
